author: Animan
description:
Did you know you probably watched the completely censored, watered-down cut of your favorite dark anime without ever realizing it? From giant black censor circles in Terra Formars to completely whited-out screens in Blood-C, Japanese broadcast standards and TV network guidelines have quietly hidden some of the most brutal scenes in anime history.

In this video, we break down 10 infamous anime where the TV broadcast cut completely butchered the source material—and reveal why the real, uncensored Blu-ray cuts tell an entirely different story.

Which of these shows did you accidentally watch the censored version of? Drop your thoughts in the comments below!
